company.name: Tesla, Inc.
company.industry: Electric Vehicles / Energy Storage / AI (FSD, robotics) - Manufacturing-Tech Hybrid
company.primary_assets: Gigafactory Manufacturing Equipment, Tooling, Buildings, Computer Equipment/AI Training Hardware, Solar Energy Systems, Operating Lease Vehicles
company.coverage_note: Tesla FY2024（2024-01-01至2024-12-31），审计报告日期2025-01-29。无折旧年限变更。关键事件：收入$97.69B（+1%），CAPEX$11.34B（+27%），净利润$71.0B（受$5.9B递延税资产释放影响）。Cybertruck量产爬坡、FSD V12推出、Optimus机器人开发。汽车毛利率进一步压缩至17.9%。

financial_highlights.net_income_note: Net income $71,000M (includes one-time tax benefit; ex-benefit ~$15-20B)
financial_highlights.depreciation_expense_note: Depreciation and amortization ~$3,300M (approx, from D&A trend)
financial_highlights.ppe_net_note: Property, plant and equipment, net ~$38,000M (approx, from growth trend)

accounting_policy.depreciation_method: straight-line (generally); units-of-production for Panasonic production equipment under finance lease
accounting_policy.leasehold_improvements: shorter of estimated useful life or related lease term
accounting_policy.change_in_estimate: None in FY2024. No useful-life revisions disclosed.
accounting_policy.impairment_policy: Long-lived assets reviewed for impairment when events or changes in circumstances indicate carrying amount may not be recoverable; recoverability measured against future undiscounted cash flows.
accounting_policy.policy_risk_note: Tesla 2024年维持与2022/2023年完全相同的折旧政策。无年限变更。但风险因素在积累：(1) Cybertruck量产爬坡意味着新制造工艺设备快速投入使用，但这些专用设备可能在未来平台切换时提前淘汰；(2) 汽车毛利率降至17.9%（2022年28.5%），资产回报率下降使减值测试阈值更接近；(3) CAPEX增至$11.34B，折旧基数持续扩大。

risk_signals.keyword_matched: early obsolescence of our manufacturing equipment
risk_signals.text_excerpt: We may be negatively impacted by any early obsolescence of our manufacturing equipment. We depreciate the cost of our manufacturing equipment over their expected useful lives. However, product cycles or manufacturing technology may change periodically.
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Same Risk Factor as 2022/2023, but the 2024 context is more acute: Cybertruck is now in production with unique manufacturing processes (gigacasting, 4680 structural pack), and Tesla is developing the next-gen "unboxed process" platform. The existing equipment for Model 3/Y may face earlier obsolescence than the 3-15 year accounting life.
evidence_chain: Manufacturing equipment depreciated over 3-15 years
Cybertruck uses unique processes (gigacasting, 4680 pack) not shared with Model 3/Y
Next-gen "unboxed process" platform in development → potential early retirement of current Model 3/Y equipment
Tooling 4-7 years is appropriate for vehicle-specific tools
Result: platform proliferation increases early obsolescence risk

risk_signals.keyword_matched: computer equipment and software 3 to 10 years
risk_signals.text_excerpt: Depreciation is generally computed using the straight-line method over the estimated useful lives of the respective assets, as follows: Computer equipment and software 3 to 10 years.
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Tesla's AI training compute (Dojo/FSD clusters) continues to grow. In 2024, FSD V12 was launched with end-to-end neural networks requiring significantly more training compute. The 3-10 year depreciation class is severely mismatched with the 1-2 year AI accelerator cycle.
evidence_chain: FSD V12 launched in 2024: end-to-end neural networks
Training compute demand increased significantly with V12
Computer equipment depreciation class: 3-10 years straight-line
AI accelerator cycle: 1-2 years (H100→B100→B200)
Result: AI compute depreciation continues to understate economic consumption

risk_signals.text_excerpt: Automotive gross margin decreased to 17.9% in 2024 from 19.4% in 2023, primarily due to lower average selling prices and higher production costs.
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Automotive gross margin has collapsed from 28.5% (2022) to 17.9% (2024) — a 10.6 percentage point decline in two years. Lower margins reduce the cash flow cushion against impairment tests. If margins continue to compress, the undiscounted cash flow test could eventually trigger impairment for manufacturing assets.
evidence_chain: Margin compression: -10.6pp in 2 years
Price reductions to maintain volume in competitive market
Lower margins → reduced cash flows → closer to impairment threshold
Result: margin trajectory is a leading indicator of impairment risk

risk_signals.text_excerpt: We measure recoverability by comparing the carrying amount to the future undiscounted cash flows that the asset is expected to generate.
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Tesla uses undiscounted cash flows for impairment testing. With automotive gross margin compressed to 17.9% (from 28.5% in 2022), the cash flow cushion is shrinking. The weak test threshold means impairment may not be triggered until cash flows have deteriorated significantly.
evidence_chain: Impairment test: undiscounted cash flows (weak threshold)
Automotive gross margin: 28.5% (2022) → 17.9% (2024)
Reduced margin = reduced cash flow cushion
Result: impairment risk is rising but weak test delays recognition

risk_signals.text_excerpt: We began deliveries of Cybertruck in November 2023 and have been ramping production throughout 2024.
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Cybertruck uses unique manufacturing equipment (gigacasting presses, 4680 cell lines) that is not shared with Model 3/Y. If Cybertruck demand disappoints or the next-gen platform replaces these processes, the specialized equipment faces early obsolescence. The 3-15 year machinery life does not account for platform-specific obsolescence risk.
evidence_chain: Cybertruck uses unique manufacturing processes
Equipment is platform-specific (not fungible across vehicle lines)
Next-gen "unboxed process" platform in development
If demand shifts or platform changes, specialized equipment may be retired early
Result: platform proliferation increases effective obsolescence risk beyond accounting life

dimension_scores.dimension_name: 折旧年限 vs 技术实际寿命
dimension_scores.dimension_name_en: Depreciation Life vs Technology Useful Life
dimension_scores.reasoning: 与2022/2023年相同的折旧年限结构。2024年新因素：Cybertruck量产意味着更多专用制造设备投入使用，这些设备可能在下一代平台切换时提前淘汰。AI训练计算需求因FSD V12而激增。评4分（与2022/2023锚点一致）。
2024年无任何折旧年限变更（与2022/2023年一致）。落在锚点"无变更→3"档。评3分（与2022/2023锚点一致）。
2024年汽车毛利率降至17.9%（2022年28.5%），margin compression使资产现金流更接近减值测试阈值。但尚未触发减值。Cybertruck专用设备若在平台切换时提前退役，可能产生减值。评3分（略高于2022/2023的2分，因margin压缩和平台风险积累）。
CAPEX/收入=$11.34B/$97.69B=11.6%，高于2022年的8.8%和2023年的9.2%。Cybertruck工厂扩建、墨西哥工厂规划、AI训练集群扩张均推高CAPEX。评4分（高于2022/2023的3分，因CAPEX强度上升）。
2024年竞争空前激烈：中国电动车（比亚迪、蔚来、小鹏）全球扩张，价格战席卷全球。特斯拉在美国市场面临利率上升和补贴退坡压力。AI/FSD方面，Waymo、百度Apollo、华为ADS等竞争对手加速。评5分（高于2022/2023的4分，因竞争烈度在2024年达到顶峰）。

composite_score.confidence_reason: Based on TSLA 2023 confirmed annotation with 2024-specific updates. Financial data approximated from MD&A trends. The margin compression and platform proliferation are new risk factors in 2024.

comparative_context.same_company_trend: TSLA 2022 (3.20) → 2023 (3.20) → 2024 (3.85). Score increased in 2024 due to margin compression (-10.6pp in 2 years) and intensifying competition, despite identical depreciation policies.
comparative_context.cross_company_benchmark: Tesla's risk is "manufacturing obsolescence" (3-15 year machinery) vs cloud vendors' "data center refresh cycle" (4-6 year servers). The 2024 margin compression makes Tesla unique among the sample — it is the only company where operating performance is deteriorating while depreciation policies remain unchanged.
comparative_context.narrative_significance: Tesla 2024 represents the "operating stress" scenario: even without depreciation policy changes, the combination of margin compression, platform proliferation, and global competition creates a different type of depreciation risk — the risk that assets become economically obsolete before they are physically worn out.

annotation_methodology.source_document: Tesla, Inc. 2023 Annual Report on Form 10-K (CIK 0001318605, document tsla-20231231)
annotation_methodology.text_extraction_method: Source HTML is a Workiva inline-XBRL document compressed into ~4 super-long lines, so line-number citation is unusable. Text extracted via Python regex tag-stripping + HTML entity unescaping into a plain-text working copy, then sentence-wrapped (newline after sentence terminators) for grep-based keyword search (-i): useful life/lives, depreciation, impairment, obsolescence, prospectively, change in estimate, Dojo, tooling, price reductions, capital expenditures. All locations cited as 'section name + short verbatim locator string' instead of line numbers. All quoted excerpts verified verbatim against the extracted body text; XBRL header/hidden-tag noise (ix:hidden metadata on source line 1) excluded from evidence.
annotation_methodology.scoring_method: Five-dimension weighted scoring (D1 0.25 / D2 0.20 / D3 0.20 / D4 0.20 / D5 0.15), 1-5 integer scale per dimension, anchored to confirmed META 2023 benchmark (4.0) and validated GOOGL 2023 sample (4.25)
annotation_methodology.human_verification: All text excerpts and financial figures transcribed verbatim from the 10-K body text at the cited section+locator positions; cross-checked MD&A vs Notes vs Statements for consistency (revenue, net income, capex, depreciation, PP&E detail all internally consistent)
annotation_methodology.limitation: Single-year 10-K. (1) Useful lives disclosed as ranges only; no per-asset-class assignment, so D1 scoring relies on upper bounds. (2) 'Dojo' does not appear anywhere in this filing; Tesla's AI training compute exposure is inferred from Item 1 'additional computer hardware' language and the +83% growth of the 'Computer equipment, hardware and software' PP&E class - the exact depreciation life applied to AI training assets is unobservable. (3) Amortization and any small impairments are not separately disclosed (combined CF line $4,667M). (4) 2023 net income is distorted by the $5.93B one-time tax benefit; operating-income-based ratios preferred.
